Package org.webharvest

Class LockedRegistry<K,​V>

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.webharvest.LockedRegistry<K,​V>
  • Type Parameters:
    K - type of key under which values are bound
    V - type of bound values
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    Registry<K,​V>
    public final class LockedRegistry<K,​V>
extends Object
implements Registry<K,​V>
    Generic locking registry implementation that follows 'decorator' design pattern. Read and write access to Registry methods are locked based on ReentrantReadWriteLock object.
    Since:
    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT
    Version:
    %I%, %G%
    Author:
    Robert Bala
